description: This file is a unit test class for the QuickLaunchAPI component in the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It contains test methods for the getAll API endpoint and for verifying that create, delete, and validation rule methods are not implemented.

classes.name: QuickLaunchAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the QuickLaunchAPI endpoints and behaviors within the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

methods.name: testGetAll1
methods.description: Tests the getAll API call with module enabled and periods defined.

methods.name: testGetAll2
methods.description: Tests the getAll API call with modules enabled but periods undefined.

methods.name: testGetAll3
methods.description: Tests the getAll API call with the leave module disabled.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForCreate throws a not implemented exception.
